plan: This is the first round, so I have no history to learn from. With rational bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid slightly below your value. I will bid a bit below my value of $36 to try and secure a profit if I win. I will bid $35.5.

I will use the Nash Equilibrium bidding strategy. With 3 bidders, the optimal bidding strategy is to bid two-thirds of my value. My value is $8, so I will bid (2/3) * 8 = 5.33. Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I will bid $5.3.

This is a single-round auction. My value is $44. The Nash Equilibrium strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid truthfully. However, since the other bidders are assumed to be rational, I should bid slightly below my value to increase my profit margin if I win. I will bid $43.9.
